name: lib/circuit-breaker
title: Circuit breaker
summary: Decides whether a call may go to a failing dependency: closed, open, half-open. Sans-IO: the host passes the time in milliseconds.

config.name: failure_threshold
config.description: Failures inside window_ms that open the circuit.

config.name: window_ms
config.description: Failures older than this are forgotten.

config.name: cooldown_ms
config.description: How long the circuit stays open before one probe.

operations.description: A closed breaker, or the reason the settings are invalid.
The call failed in a way that counts.
The call says nothing about the dependency (cancelled, a caller error).
Closed, Open or HalfOpen at now.

invariants.text: A zero threshold, window or cooldown is refused at construction.
The circuit opens on the failing call, not on the next one.
Failures older than window_ms are forgotten.
Half-open admits exactly one probe; its success closes the circuit.
A failed probe reopens for a full cooldown.
A released probe frees the slot without judging the dependency.
An outcome from a call admitted before the circuit opened is ignored.
A clock that steps back never panics or underflows.
